Q-4875: What is the greatest common divisor of 143 and 253?

GCD(143, 253) = 11.

Check: 143 = 11 × 13, 253 = 11 × 23. Euclidean algorithm: 253 - 143 = 110; 143 - 110 = 33; 110 mod 33 = 11; 33 mod 11 = 0.
